name: Davor Ivo Stier - § 29
title: REPORT on EU political strategy on Latin America
part_text: Welcomes the conclusion of the negotiations on the EU-Mercosur Partnership Agreement and highlights the geopolitical importance of the adoption and implementation of this agreement; highlights the fact that the agreement would be a real game changer for the relationship between the two regions, as it would be the largest trade agreement ever signed by the EU in terms of population, covering more than 700 million citizens, and the most significant in terms of its economic impact; stresses its geopolitical value as an essential tool for advancing the EU’s strategic interests in the current international context;
